text:
Centre County woman indicted for production and possession of child pornography
Shannon M. Ishler, age 45, of Bellefonte, Pennsylvania, was indicted by a federal grand jury for the production of child pornography by a person having custody or control of a minor and possession of child pornography, according to an announcement from the United States Attorney’s Office for the Middle District of Pennsylvania on Sep. 16.
United States Attorney Brian D. Miller said the indictment alleges that between January 1 and April 5, 2024, Ishler produced several images depicting child exploitation involving multiple toddlers in her care and distributed them over the internet. The indictment also alleges that Ishler possessed visual depictions of minors engaged in sexually explicit conduct.
The case was investigated by FBI Philadelphia’s Capital Area Resident Agency and the Pennsylvania State Police. Assistant U.S. Attorney Luisa Honora Berti is prosecuting the case.
This case is part of Project Safe Childhood, a nationwide initiative launched in May 2006 by the Department of Justice to combat child sexual exploitation and abuse. The program brings together federal, state, and local resources to locate offenders who exploit children and to identify victims.
The maximum penalty under federal law for these offenses is up to 30 years’ imprisonment, supervised release following imprisonment, and a fine. Sentencing will be determined by a judge after consideration of relevant statutes and guidelines.
Indictments are only allegations; all persons charged are presumed innocent unless found guilty in court. The U.S. Attorney for the Middle District of Pennsylvania serves about 3.2 million residents across more than 21,900 square miles with offices in Harrisburg, Scranton, Williamsport and Wilkes-Barre; it handles prosecutions of federal crimes as well as civil litigation for the government and victim assistance programs while promoting community safety through initiatives like Project Safe Neighborhoods, according to its official website.
